threat_crosswalk.closure_rule: no attack or acceptance requirement may be reported covered unless its matrix row contains component, oracle, contradiction/unavailable outcome, evidence paths and two-process replay fields

replay_contract.replays_definition: number of independent OS processes consuming identical frozen input

field_rules.source_paths: absolute or repository-relative paths resolved against frozen cwd; every path must exist at capture time
field_rules.source_hashes: reviewer recomputes bytes; implementation-printed hashes are not authoritative
field_rules.candidate_binding: exact candidate URI/ref and identity; absent authority is typed_absent/terminal_deferred, never synthetic present
field_rules.derived_classification: must be calculated from mutated typed input and source/invariant rules; expected_error is assertion-only
field_rules.numeric_exit_code: required even for nonzero or interrupted runs; missing exit artifact is inadmissible
field_rules.raw_streams: raw bytes retained; empty stderr is represented by a real empty file and hash, not omitted
field_rules.semantic_output: must exclude process metadata but include case rows, diagnosis, canonical bytes and hashes
field_rules.test_labels: every fixture/output/receipt in this protocol has TEST_ONLY=true and non_evidence=true

terminal_deferred_on: provider unavailable where contract declares an external gap
typed absent source/input with no contradiction
inadmissible_on: determinism row with fewer than two independent processes
synthetic low-level input presented as formal B04 input

program_exception.meaning: unexpected runtime/transport fault, distinct from contract fail_closed and external terminal_deferred
program_exception.reduction: force at least rework; only a separately proven unavailable external root may reduce it to block_external; never pass_limited

not_applicable.meaning: row intentionally excluded from this R2 scope
not_applicable.reduction: not_applicable cannot satisfy a mandatory row; allowed only for rows explicitly future_locked/forbidden_this_round

reduction_context.pass: pass_limited only when the expected positive oracle matches
reduction_context.fail_closed: pass_limited for an expected contradiction/tamper negative; rework for an unexpected rejection or missing negative
reduction_context.terminal_deferred: pass_limited for an expected typed-absence software boundary; block_external when required external authority remains unavailable at the integration gate

verdict_schema.pass_limited_scope: bounded contract/software preparation only; no full UP1, B00/B04, provider, mesh, solver, engineering, physical or R01-R10 credit
verdict_schema.rework_scope: local implementation, test, or receipt defect; rerun from a new revision after repair
verdict_schema.block_external_scope: required external authority/source/provider or provenance is unavailable or cannot be established
